heading: Why ATLAS is the Right Choice for B.Sc. Finance

panes.title: Multiple Pathways to Global Careers
panes.text: Pursue global certifications through partners like NSE, NISM, ACCA and FPSB, alongside CFA, FRM or Actuarial Science, opening careers in Investment Banking, FinTech, Wealth Management, Financial Planning and MBA Finance.

panes.title: Industry-Aligned Curriculum
panes.text: Go beyond classroom learning with a program that integrates global standards in investment analysis, financial markets and valuation. Designed to equip students with skills that are immediately applicable to industry requirements.

panes.title: Learning from Industry Experts
panes.text: Engage with CFA Charterholders, finance professionals and industry leaders through guest lectures, workshops, seminars and networking sessions that bridge theoretical knowledge with practical application.

panes.title: Experiential Learning in Real Financial Environments
panes.text: Gain hands-on exposure through corporate visits, banking immersions, stock market interactions and direct engagement with leading financial institutions and business environments.

panes.title: Strong Academic Foundation in Finance
panes.text: Build depth in financial thinking with 1,600+ hours of structured learning, specialisation from Semester 1, 24 finance-focused courses and advanced pedagogy emphasising analytical and decision-making skills.
